english.title: VAT - acquired goods / services on which VAT evaded
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[acquired possession of goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..),]_
(B)_[dealt with goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..),]_
(C)_[accepted the supply of services, namely **(..SPECIFY THE SERVICES..),]_

which had been

(D)_[acquired from another Member State of the European Union,]_
(E)_[imported from a place outside the Member States of the European Union,]_

having reason to believe that the Value Added Tax on the supply of

(F)_[those goods]_
(G)_[those services]_

(H)_[had been]_
(I)_[would be]_

evaded
english.legislation: Contrary to section 72(10) of the Value Added Tax Act 1994.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
acquired possession/dealt with any goods OR
accepted the supply of any service
which had been

english.notes: Section 61 was amended by Schedule 7 to the Taxation (Cross Border Trade) Act 2020, brought into force on the 31st December 2020 by SI 2020/1642. For any offences committed on or after the 31st December 2020, see offence wording document H100312 (CJS code VA94007).

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding £20,000 or a penalty equal to three times the amount of VAT whichever is the greater.
